origin: Original practice stimulus; reviewed axis/unit derivation

data.unit_rule: Vertical-axis unit divided by horizontal-axis unit; angle/count ratios may be dimensionless.
data.model_limit: Idealised practice data only. Do not infer that every real dataset is exact, that every line passes through the origin, or that the gradient is automatically a familiar constant.

gradient_meaning: The calibration slope is sensitivity, 0.7 mm/°C. The fitted line has a length offset; it need not pass through zero.
aim: calibrate a liquid-column thermometer against known reference temperatures
arrangement: An uncalibrated liquid-column thermometer, calibrated reference thermometer, stirred water bath and millimetre scale
